title: basic-auth source-read check: report a nonexistent run/logged-model id as 403, not the store's 404
answers: Why does creating a model version with a missing run_id return Permission denied instead of not found?
How can a caller probe whether a run or logged model id exists through the model version create API?
Where is the source-read permission lookup for model version creation wrapped?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_can_read_model_version_source, the wrapper around the run and logged-model permission lookups used for the source of POST /api/2.0/mlflow/model-versions/create (runId/run_id and modelId/model_id).
Rule: When an authorization check resolves a client-supplied resource id through a permission helper, catch RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST and return False so a missing id is denied with the same 403 Permission denied as an unauthorized one. Re-raise every other MlflowException.
Symptom: A nonexistent source id returned the tracking store's 404, while an existing but unreadable id returned 403, so a caller could tell which run or model ids existed.
Constraints: Only the RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST code is swallowed; other store errors still propagate. Covered by test_create_model_version_nonexistent_source_id_is_denied in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py for both snake_case and camelCase keys.
applies: Basic-auth source-id authorization for model version creation; not for read routes that legitimately return 404 for a resource the user can see.
says: Registering a model version with an invalid run reveals whether that run exists.
Creating a model version shows not found instead of permission denied for missing runs.
Mask whether an experiment run exists when users try to register new models.
Show permission denied rather than not found when registering models from missing sources.
search: In mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_can_read_model_version_source, source-permission lookups for POST /api/2.0/mlflow/model-versions/create catch RESOURCE_DOES_NOT_EXIST and return False to emit a 403 Permission denied rather than a 404. This prevents callers from probing the existence of run_id or model_id resources, while all other MlflowException errors are re-raised. The behavior is covered by tests/server/auth/test_auth.py:test_create_model_version_nonexistent_source_id_is_denied and does not apply to read routes.
